chunks: But if you desire God, His Apostle, and the life to come, then God has verily prepared for those of you who are good, a great reward.

key_terms.الدَّارَ الْآخِرَةَ: The Hereafter / the abode of the afterlife
key_terms.لِلْمُحْسِنَاتِ: For the women who do good / the virtuous women

ai.seo_question: What is the reward for the wives of the Prophet who seek the Hereafter?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often interpreted as addressing the specific status of the Prophet's wives, particularly highlighting Fatimah al-Zahra (peace be upon her) as the ultimate exemplar of 'al-muhsinat' (the good-doers). It underscores the principle that spiritual merit is determined by sincere devotion to God, His Messenger, and the eternal abode, rather than mere proximity to the Prophet. This reinforces the Shia emphasis on the interconnection of divine love, prophetic guidance, and eschatological reward.
